content.title: Marvel Rivals Season 7 Rotates Out Jeffnado & Duality Dance, Adds New Team-Ups Including Luna Snow + White Fox
content.text: Marvel Rivals Season 7 is just around the corner, set for release on March 20, 2026. This new season marks the arrival of the latest Strategist Hero, White Fox, new maps, new mechanic changes, and, of course, the seasonal Team-Up changes, removals, and additions. In Marvel Rivals Season 7, minor Team-Up changes are being made compared to some previous Seasons. However, the changes that are being made are certainly interesting, involving Storm, Jeff the Land Shark, Adam Warlock, Luna Snow, and White Fox.Marvel Rivals Season 7 Team-Ups: Jeffnado & Duality Bond RemovedFirst off, the natural Team-Up removals. Each season has them, usually removing some of the older, more frustrating, or ‘unbalanced’ options on the roster. On the other hand, some Team-Ups are also removed to ensure no one hero has too many of them at a time (looking at you, Human Torch, from a couple of seasons ago…).When it comes to Marvel Rivals Season 7, the iconic Jeffnado will be no more. That’s right, Marvel’s Jeff + Storm Sharknado is being removed. This takes away Storm’s only Team-Up, leaving her open for a new option, while Jeff remains with his Deadpool + Elsa Bloodstone Team-Up.Luna Snow and Adam Warlock’s Duality Dance is also being removed in Season 7, with both of these heroes now gaining new Team-Ups to replace them. New Team-Ups Involve Luna Snow + White Fox & Adam Warlock + StormAs mentioned earlier, while Storm, Adam, and Luna are all having their Team-Ups removed, all three of these heroes are gaining new Team-Up abilities to replace them.Storm and Adam Warlock will now have a Team-Up together. Adam loses his Team-Up Anchor bonus from Duality Bond through its removal, but instead gains a new ‘Heavenly Harmony’ ability through his new Cosmic Cyclone Team-Up with Storm. This time around, Storm is the Anchor, gaining increased damage.Adam’s Heavenly Harmony ability is a passive ability that enhances his recent flight addition. When Storm is present on the team, Adam’s flight speed is increased, and he leaves a golden aura trail in his path (similar to how Cloak and Dagger Ultimate works). Any ally who passes through this aura gets a speed boost and healing.Luna Snow, on the other hand, gets a Team-Up ability with the brand-new Strategist Hero, White Fox. Perhaps these two will be a strong dual-support combo for various team compositions through this new ‘Blessing of the Kumiho’ Team-up. White Fox is the Anchor hero, gaining increased healing, while Luna Snow gains a new ability titled Spirit Fox Accord. Luna’s Spirit Fox Accord provides her with an ability on a 20-second cooldown, sending a fox out in a straight line, through both allies and enemies. It heals affected allies and charms affected enemies, plus provides Luna with a temporary speed boost.
